en: You've already seen this, do you want to skip it?
This morning, we prepared everything we needed.
Food, drinks, utensils—even the rental cart we were gonna use.
Today we're going to the river!
“Coming here really was a great idea!”
“Is it me? Or is Shizuko super excited...?”
“Yeah! She's been waiting for this for ages!”
“You guys eat so well all the time now...”
“I wanna have a big feast with loads of meat and booze too!”
“I'm excited too, to be honest. We haven't all been out together in a while.”
“When was the last time we all went out together?”
“We've all just been so busy with our own stuff.”
“We've really brought a lot of food.”
“Hehe... I got this just for today!”
“You guys take care of getting fresh fish!”
“I didn't think you guys were really going to fish.”
“I was shocked that they actually had a fishing rod at home.”
“Haha, that's dad's rod. We used to come fishing here with him a lot when we were younger.”
“Oh, looks like we'll be having fish today after all!”
“But don't get your hopes up too much. That was when we were younger.”
“You're getting really good with a knife.”
“Are you learning to cook from {Me}, Kasumi?”
“Why're you looking at me like that?”
“Yeah, I kind of expected you to be a good cook.”
“When you live alone you really do have to do a lot. If it were me, I'd surely make a mess of it all.”
“What're you looking at me like that for?”
“It's just... I just boil food, that's all.”
“Please just say I'm not the best.”
“Shizuko, you're a beautiful young woman, you need to pay attention to stuff like that.”
“Hey, you should come over for dinner!”
“Yeah, I love having lots of people around!”
“Why did you bring cans of food to a barbecue?”
“Are you that desperate to eat fish?”
“*A-hem*... No... Honestly, I have no idea what that's doing here either...”
“Why do you all look so worried?”
“I'm not sure if it goes well with alcohol.”
“You haven't heard of this brand, Kasumi?”
“Yeah it's pretty famous, for smelling like...”
“Hey, Shizuko, what do we do with this?”
“Chuck it, unless you wanna eat it?”
“I told ya I don't know why it's here.”
“Didn't you double check what you were getting the company to pay for?”
“...When you put it like that, maybe the shop has some in their food supply too.”
“Anyway, it's no big deal. Let's talk about what an opportunity this is, who wants to try it?”
“I haven't actually smelled it, but I don't want to risk the biohazard.”
“Don't tell me you wanna open it?”
“Have you thought about what you'll do if you can't eat it?”
“Ha... Okay, let's pretend it doesn't exist.”
“Hehe, let's keep going, we should be ready to BBQ soon!”
Suddenly, there's a commotion in the woods behind us.
Two monkeys suddenly come rushing towards us and snatch the food from our hands.
They snatch some fruit and... the can from hell.
At first, the monkey isn't sure what to do with the can and just keeps tapping it with its teeth and fingers.
By the time we're able to react, the monkey has already thrown the can down on the ground.
The monkey looks like it's remembering something and charges at us again.
We're all on guard this time. I thought the monkey was going to snatch more food, but it had its sights on something else.
Its target is the crate of beer off to the side.
No, the monkey is going for the... can opener.
“This monkey—knows how to use a can opener?”
We watch as the monkey uses the utensil to open the can.
Kasumi slowly inches forward, but the monkey is on guard and it slowly retreats.
“Looks like this isn't going to be straightforward...”
“Not to worry, we still have a backup opener...”
“But the most important thing is that can of herring is about to explode!”
*tear*—followed by the sound of leaking gas.
And a smell that none of them can really explain...
The monkeys can't cope with the smell and they throw the can right back at me.
“You see how awesome your sister is?”
“Pffft, you were just lucky is all.”
“Exactly five fish. C'mon, let's go back, they're probably eating!”
“But Ayano, can you smell that strange smell?”
“I've got a bad feeling about this.”
“Apart from that strange smell, I can't see anything weird around here...?”
“Why are all three of you down on the ground...?”
“Don't you feel like it's getting worse...?”
“Honestly, I thought I was gonna hurl just now.”
Despite everything that happened... the barbecue was a blast!
